body: Review trail for M2: reviewer findings R1-R6, break-it gaps B1-B4, and one bug found by the builder during investigation. No user catches at this gate. B2/B3/B4 tests are in tests/test_feed.py and tests/test_trader.py (859e87f).

comments.body: Caught (reviewer): a kill switch that tripped while the model was thinking did not stop that decision from trading (R1). Now held as `killed`. Fixed in f341991.

Caught (reviewer): float residue (e.g. 4.3e-19) left after closing several entries made the bot think it was still long and blocked every sell signal (R2). Position now snaps to exactly 0 below this. Fixed in 2fd8b9f.
Caught (reviewer): the same residue reached the policy as a real position (R2). Anything under half a lot is now treated as flat. Fixed in 2fd8b9f.

Caught (reviewer): after the stale watchdog tripped with the feed down, run() waited for a next book that never came and hung (R3). It now races the next book against the stop event. Fixed in d42e440.
Caught (reviewer): a timed-out model thread kept running and every snapshot started another predict call (R4). Later snapshots now hold until the running call finishes. Fixed in 243845b.
Caught (reviewer): a mid-decision trip logged two kill_switch events (R5). Fixed in 6754608.

Caught (builder, while investigating): the float position 0.00015999... was floored to 0.00015, so a reduce-only close left one lot open with no exit scheduled. Position is now snapped to the nearest lot first. Fixed in a48d328.
Caught (reviewer, break-it): deleting the partial-exit retry passed all 240 tests. Now guarded by test_partial_exit_is_retried_at_the_next_book. Fixed in 859e87f.
Caught (reviewer, break-it): feed backoff never resetting or never doubling passed all tests. Now guarded by this test. Fixed in 859e87f.
Caught (reviewer): SQLite WAL/SHM files could hold decision data and be picked up by `git add .` (R6). Fixed in 6754608.
